items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: After Jelly Roll, I was with Ory at that time. Ory was in the band with us.

ctx.x: And I went up to him and I said, 'Say, how would you like to play in a band?' 'All right.' He said yeah and gave me his name. And I said, 'I'll tell Ory.' He said, 'Yeah, I'll go.' So I told Ory, I said, 'I heard a guy who sounds pretty good to me.' Sounded pretty good. 'All right. Call him over and I'll call a rehearsal.' So he had a rehearsal and had Johnnie come over, he came out there and got on the band,

items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: Me and Orrie then got together.

ctx.x: No. I mean, didn't you say that's how Muskrat Ramble started?
Yeah. That's the way Orrie got pretty much 'Muskrat Ramble.'
